name: Exhausted
description: Generic bone-tired state. Apply with [state <char> -> exhausted]. Layers heavy fatigue onto the character; overlays append to existing anatomy prose.

properties.affect_summary: Exhausted — running on empty, every movement an effort. Slow to respond, short on patience, fighting to keep her eyes open.
properties.mannerism_overlay: Stifles yawns, rubs her eyes, leans on whatever's nearest, lets sentences trail off, blinks long and slow.

body_overlays.head: Her eyes are heavy and shadowed with fatigue, lids drooping; her face has the slack, drained look of someone running on fumes.
body_overlays.arms: Her arms hang heavy and loose, the energy gone out of them.
body_overlays.legs: Her legs feel leaden, steps dragging, weight sagging toward whatever she can lean on.
